data.one_liner: A glassmorphic navigation bar widget with gradient support, badges, and smooth animations.
data.what_it_does: Provides a customizable bottom navigation bar widget featuring glassmorphism, gradient backgrounds, optional text labels, and animated tab transitions. It adapts to platform guidelines for iOS and Android and integrates with light and dark themes.
use_when: You want a modern glassmorphic bottom navigation bar in your Flutter app.
You need custom gradients, floating buttons, and smooth transition animations on tabs.
You require built-in light and dark theme adaptation for navigation.
avoid_when: You need standard Material NavigationBar or CupertinoTabBar implementations.
Your app uses navigation paradigms other than a bottom navigation bar.
strengths: Aesthetically pleasing glassmorphism and gradient options.
Supports smooth programmatic navigation using a GlobalKey.
Light and dark theme support via factory constructors.
weaknesses: Limited to bottom navigation bar use cases.
Relies on custom styling parameters rather than strictly adhering to native Material or Cupertino specs.
